610:t_2:143.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yeah... Thanks to the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, we can keep track of $$エスター$$'s condition better than before.」

610:t_2:144.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Got it. I'll trust you, Chief.」

610:t_2:145.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll live up to that trust. Without fail.」

610:t_2:148.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It's only because it's Miss $$エスター$$... because she's only controlling phenomena on the scale of this $$ソーラリアン$$... that she can still keep a human form...)

610:t_2:149.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If you ever use the power of the twelve $$スフィア$$ again... the power of a god... then at that time...)

610:t_2:151.en:
$n
(But if the time comes when I have to do that... I...)

610:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It seems a great many things happened while I was away.」

610:t_10:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「They did. But I believe that every bit of it had meaning.」

610:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I could feel it even from afar, Miss $$マリーダ$$. That you were fighting with your life on the line.」

610:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the $$Ｚチップ$$ born of that result... a whopping 1500 Z! I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

610:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's not exactly a thank-you for that, but please, have some ice cream.」

610:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's from a shop that's the talk of $$インダストリアル７$$, recommended by Mr. $$バナージ$$.」

610:t_10:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「...Since you went to the trouble, I'll have some.」

610:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well done, Miss $$マリーダ$$... Allow me to offer my blessings to you, who overturned your fate.)

610:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Your vivid way of living influenced many people.)

610:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 1000 Z that it produced... I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

610:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And we swear to your soul that we will overturn fate...)

610:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have returned after a long absence, but this place truly does put me most at ease...」

610:t_10:23.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So this is the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ I've heard so much about.」

610:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my... Other than Lady $$ハマーン$$, I doubt there is anyone else so perfectly suited to being addressed as 'Lady'.」

610:t_10:26.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Spare me the pointless flattery. I'm no longer the $$クィーン$$ of $$クロノ$$. I'm a member of this $c now.」

610:t_10:28.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I know. The rules around here, too.」

610:t_10:29.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「It's best to get unpleasant things over with quickly. Let's do it.」

610:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

610:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, you were quite into it, weren't you?」

610:t_10:34.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Honestly... it's embarrassing, so stop going on about it...」

610:t_10:35.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「What on earth is the point of making me say things like this...」

610:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The earnestness and innocence beneath that haughty mask... Irresistible...」

610:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Now then, from today I will be going to the front lines as well. As my outfitting fund, I have prepared $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 2000 Z.」

610:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Those who have not yet upgraded their $$Ｚクリスタル$$, please use these, for the sake of the $$ソーラリアン$$'s event control as well.」

611:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「A joint operation of all three armies of the $$新地球皇国$$... It is truly a magnificent sight.」

611:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「All that remains is to add victory to it, and it will be perfect.」

611:t_000:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「There is no need to worry. A sure-win strategy has been prepared as well.」

611:t_000:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「A sure win... is it?」

611:t_000:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「If there's any problem with that, call it a complete victory, a crushing victory, a sweeping victory, or a conquering victory. Any of them will do.」

611:t_000:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems the only word in the $$ハイアデス$$ dictionary is 'victory'.」

611:t_000:6.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「We are facing an enemy we cannot beat unless we rouse ourselves like that.」

611:t_000:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Forget it, Miss $$尸刻$$. I am $$ダバラーン・タウ$$... victory is the only thing I aim for.」

611:t_000:9.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Understood. I, $$尸刻$$, also... promise to contribute to your victory, General.」

611:t_000:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Allow me to thank you. And I pledge my victory to you.」

611:t_000:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...Is that all right, General $$ダバラーン$$? I might go and tell Lady $$エルーナルーナ$$ and Lord $$尸空#pilot$$ on you.」

611:t_000:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If there were a man sidling up to his little sister, even Lord $$尸空#pilot$$ might get angry, you know.」

611:t_000:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... so you didn't know.」

611:t_000:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well then, now that you've had a chance to relax, let us welcome $c.」

611:t_001:0.en:
$$渓$$
「Look! The adjutants of all three forces are together!」

611:t_001:1.en:
$$凱$$
「So that's it, three powers combined into one!」

611:t_001:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Exactly! Can you break through this impregnable formation, $c!」

611:t_001:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Whatever you say, we're going through, $$サイデリアル$$!」

611:t_001:4.en:
$$葵$$
「Thanks to learning the truth, our anger at you guys has swelled many times over!」

611:t_001:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Almost simultaneously, counteroffensives by the Earth side have begun all over the world.」

611:t_001:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「To make the assault on $$ラース・バビロン$$ succeed, we must take $$セントラル・ベース$$, the heart of this Central Asian front.」

611:t_001:7.en:
$$レド$$
「If we break through here, it's a straight line to the Emperor from there!」

611:t_001:8.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If a Reactor is waiting for us in the imperial capital, we'll take down its adjutants here!」

611:t_001:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's been a while, this feeling... It feels like I've come back.」

611:t_001:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... um... well... about the other day... that was... I just got a little carried away... I mean... um...」

611:t_001:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「See! It was such a dramatic reunion, and the mood got way too heated!」

611:t_001:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So, um... please don't think too much about it...」

611:t_001:15.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop. Let's leave anything past that until after the fighting is over.」

611:t_001:16.en:
$n
「You mean after we take $$セントラル・ベース$$?」

611:t_001:18.en:
$n
「After we defeat $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ at $$ラース・バビロン$$?」

611:t_001:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Nope. Not until $$蒼の地球$$ and $$翠の地球$$ are completely at peace.」
